label: [early-0244] W1 levels core: kill XP, sharing, catch-up, one rules file
task: Needs on origin: ext/early-base. Base: origin/ext/early-base. Branch: ext/early-levels-core. Spec: origin/ext/spec-early-camps:briefs/specs/EARLY_CAMPS_DROP.md sections 1, 2.4 and all of 6 (6.9 has the rules file). Owner rule 11-10: Hunters level only by kills. No XP over time, no XP for damage, a monster's XP goes to the last hit and that Hunter's squadmates nearby, hitting Hunters only builds armor. First write docs/decisions/NNNN-levels-kill-xp.md (match flow and combat are core systems). Build: new content/rules/xp.json exactly as in section 6.9 and new scripts/match/xp_rules.gd (XpRules), the only reader of it and the only caller of Hunter.gain_xp. XpRules owns: the curve (to_level, level_for), mob_xp(mob) = the table x the rarity multiplier (0 for anything a boss or monster summoned: tag those at spawn), pace_level(match time), pace_mult(hunter), knock_xp(receiver, victim), and pay_kill(match, killer, pos, xp, from_monster): the one place that knows the 30 m rule. It pays the killer and each squadmate alive or downed within share_r of pos in full, applies pace_mult per receiver for monster XP only, and emits one CombatBus event (hunter, amount, source: camp/monster/boss/knock, pos) that the HUD, the steal callouts and the results readout will listen to. Remove, do not reduce: the trickle in scripts/match/hunter.gd near line 1918; the gain_xp on damage in scripts/match/match.gd near 1783 (the armor_gain line under it stays as it is); the flat 90 knock XP near match.gd 1850 (becomes XpRules.knock_xp: 40 + 15 x the victim's level, +30 per level the victim is above the receiver, half when the victim is 2 or more below, at most once per victim every 45 s, shared within 30 m of the victim; ARMOR_KNOCK_XP stays); the share table in scripts/match/lairs.gd near 709 (the boss pays 300 to the last hit's squad members inside the lair, nothing to other squads). Monster death (match.gd near 2214) gets one wiring line to XpRules.pay_kill with the credit it already has. A Boki's or summon's last hit counts for its Hunter; a death with no Hunter credit pays nobody. Move into xp.json and delete at the source: Hunter.XP_TO and ULT_AT, content/rules/level_growth.json (scripts/match/level_growth.gd reads the growth block through XpRules), and the cut rolling mode's XP scaling in scripts/match/rolling.gd (scale_xp, GAP_KNOCK_XP, BOUNTY_XP) with its callers: one catch-up system. hunter.gd and match.gd must end shorter than they started. Grep for every other gain_xp caller (perk orb demo, bots) and route or delete it: no bot-only XP. Revive floor: where a dead Hunter is brought back (scripts/match/box_revive.gd, scripts/match/beacons.gd) one call lifts them to revive_floor levels under their squad's highest living member if lower; level, XP, ability ranks, weapon steps and armor tier are kept; nothing is lost on a down or a death. Net: read how gain_xp and monster deaths are synced today (each client grants its own Hunters from the deaths it sees; hunter_net.gd already sends the level) and keep that authority; bump Net.VERSION only if a sync field is added. Proving check: new tools/levels_check.gd registered as `--levels-check`. It asserts: the curve and that a first Small Camp's 60 XP is exactly level 2; every id in Data.MOBS has an entry in xp.json; a Hunter standing still for 120 s gains 0; 500 damage to a monster and to a Hunter gain 0 XP and the same armor progress as before; the killer and two squadmates at 10 m and 29 m each get the full XP, one at 31 m gets 0, a downed one in range gets it, a dead one does not; a rival's last hit after 95% damage by another squad pays only the rival; rarity multipliers; summoned monsters pay 0; the knock formula at three level gaps, its share, its 45 s lock, nothing for a finish; pace_level at each table time and pace_mult for gaps -4 to +4, on monster XP only; the lair boss pays 300 to the last hit's squad only; the revive floor; growth and ultimate levels read from xp.json match the old values. Fix every check that asserted the old XP numbers and say why in the commit. Run `--levels-check`, `--level-vfx-check`, `--box-revive-check`, `--revive-net-check`, `--check`, then `python3 tools/health.py --strict`. Report lines added and removed. label: [early-0244] W1 camps core: the Camps module (after levels core)
task: Needs on origin: ext/early-levels-core. Base: origin/ext/early-levels-core. Branch: ext/early-camps-core. Spec: origin/ext/spec-early-camps:briefs/specs/EARLY_CAMPS_DROP.md sections 2.1, 2.3, 2.10, 6.3, 6.4, 6.6. Goal: camps are the early game's XP, with a fixed size, one reward and one comeback. First write docs/decisions/NNNN-camps.md. New scripts/match/camps.gd and content/rules/camps.json. Move the body of Match._spawn_mobs (scripts/match/match.gd near 972) into it: match.gd and hunter.gd must end no longer than they started. Camps reads world.camp_spots ({pos, island, kind}) and keeps an explicit state per camp: LIVE, CLEARED, RETURNING, SPENT. Sizes by kind, composition fixed so a size is its XP: light = Small Camp, 2 small monsters (60 XP), reward armor 25; normal = Camp, 2 small + a Sentinel (110), armor 50 plus a perk orb half the time; heavy = Great Camp, the region's Brute + 3 small (190), armor 50 plus one perk orb plus one gear piece at the region's rarity; chief = a Great Camp whose Brute is an Elite, the Camp Chief (260; reuse the existing rarity tier and BiomeRun.dress), gear one rarity step up. Which small monsters stays BiomeRun.camp_comp. Camp monsters are always common rarity except the Chief. In the hot zone (HotZone.region_at) every camp spawns one size up. XP: camps.json holds no XP. Each camp monster pays on its own death through XpRules.pay_kill (already wired by levels core); Camps only tags monsters with their camp id. Camps.camp_xp(id) and Camps.region_xp(region) sum XpRules.mob_xp over the monsters alive. Reward: when a camp's last monster dies, drop the reward as one bundle where it fell (reuse PerkOrbs.drop with a new source 'camp' in content/rules/perk_orbs.json and the existing armor and gear drops). The bundle can be picked up only by the squad that landed that last kill for steal.reserve_s (8 s) from xp.json, then by anyone; the same reserve applies to the Watcher's treasure and orbs and a lair boss's drops. Reuse the owner argument the drops already carry if it can reserve; otherwise add one timer, not a second pickup system. Camp monsters skip the per-monster rolls in match.gd near 2236 (Brute orb 50%, valuable 25%, seeds 35% and 12%); the Rift Key chance and monsters outside camps keep theirs. Comeback: once per camp, 150 s after its clear, one size up (Small to Camp, Camp to Great, Great to Camp Chief), only if no Hunter is within 30 m and Camps.safe_for(pos, 60.0) is true; none after 7:00; never more than 85 camp monsters alive. Camps.safe_for is one function that wraps the Blight ring radius at now + 60 s (the Limited Way Outs zone work replaces only that function). Delete CAMP_RESPAWN, _camp_respawns and note_camp from scripts/match/rolling.gd with their callers: move the logic, do not copy it. API the other tasks use: Camps.list() returning {id, pos, size, state, back_t, region, xp} per camp, Camps.nearest_live(pos, r), Camps.region_xp(region), Camps.safe_for(pos, s), and a cleared(id, squad) signal. Net: keep today's authority for monster deaths; if camp state or the bundle's owner needs a new synced field, send it through Net and bump Net.VERSION. Proving check: new tools/camps_check.gd registered as `--camps-check`. It asserts: monster kinds, count and summed XP per size (60, 110, 190, 260); all camp monsters common except the Chief; XP is paid per monster kill and nothing extra on the clear; the bundle per size, no per-monster rolls from camp monsters; the bundle goes to the squad with the camp's last kill, a rival cannot pick it up for 8 s and can after; hot zone one size up; the comeback happens once, bigger, and is blocked by a near Hunter, by the Blight, and after 7:00; the 85 cap; region_xp drops as monsters die. Run `--camps-check`, `--levels-check`, `--hot-zone-check`, `--check`, then `python3 tools/health.py --strict`. Report lines added and removed. Post READY on briefs/EXT_TO_MAIN.md with `ready-post 'READY ext/early-camps-core <sha> (camps: fixed sizes, one reward bundle, one comeback)'`.

Planning phase (scripts/match/drop_squad.gd, the bot ping): a bot squad leader with no human ping picks a camp, not a spot. The hot zone first at the existing HotZone.BOT_PICK 0.35 if no other squad has pinged it; otherwise a rim or mid region that at most one other squad has pinged, pinging its Small Camp (rim) or Camp (mid). Never two bot squads in one region; at most one bot squad a match takes the Crown. After landing: clear the region's camps from smallest to biggest using Camps.nearest_live, staying within 25 m of each other so the squad shares XP; skip a camp where a squad with a higher best level is fighting; leave when Camps.safe_for(pos, 60.0) turns false or the Blight is within 40 m. From 2:00 the existing Limited Way Outs objectives lead, with these level rules: a squad at or below XpRules.pace_level detours to a live, safe camp within 60 m, a squad above it does not; a squad one level short of an even level or of 6 prefers a camp to a fight; a squad avoids a rival 2 or more levels above its best unless that rival is already in a fight, and presses one 2 or more below. Steals: a bold bot within 25 m of a prize monster (steal.prize in xp.json) at or under 25% health tries the last hit 35% of the time; a bot squad that has seen a rival within 30 m in the last 5 s stops at 30% on a prize monster, then bursts. Proving check: new tools/camp_pace_check.gd registered as `--camp-pace-check`, a seeded headless run of 10 bot trios on the 2x map over 5 seeds, to 12:00, that prints one table (squad, level at 2:00, 2:30, 4:00, 5:15, 8:00, 10:00, XP by source from the XpRules event) and asserts: every XP point is in the event tally (nothing from time or damage); bot squads average level 3.5 to 4.5 at 2:30; no Hunter is level 6 before 2:30 in at least 4 of 5 seeds; the median squad still alive is level 5.5 or more at 5:15 and 7 or more at 8:00; the top squad is at most 2 levels above the median at 4:00 and at most 3 at 8:00; at least 85% of all XP earned by 2:30 is from camp monsters; a squad scripted never to kill is level 1 at 12:00; a squad scripted to lose two Hunters at 2:00 and revive them is within 2 levels of the median at 6:00; squadmates of one squad are within 1 level of each other at 4:00 in at least 8 of 10 squads; no two bot squads ping one region. If the pace misses, tune content/rules/xp.json (monster XP, pace table) and camps.json by at most 20% and report the change; do not widen the check. Also run `--camps-check`, `--levels-check`, `--hot-zone-check`, `--bot-kit-use`, `--simtest --teams=10 --squad=3 --god` to its end with no script errors, and `python3 tools/health.py --strict`. Post READY on briefs/EXT_TO_MAIN.md with `ready-post 'READY ext/early-camps-bots <sha> (bots farm, fight and steal by level; pace sim green)'`.
